CREATE TRIGGER "lawful_steer_scope_psi" BEFORE INSERT ON "SteerScope" WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Steer" WHERE "id" = NEW."steer" AND "kind" = 1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'steer scope requires a Repartition steer'); END
CREATE TRIGGER "lawful_attempt_window" BEFORE INSERT ON "Attempt" WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Attempt" WHERE "task" = NEW."task") >= 8 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'attempt window exceeded'); END
